✨ Tabminal | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, persistent, and cross-device terminal and development workspace experience, enabling users to code and manage systems from any device.
✨ Key Features: • Persistent terminal sessions • Built-in workspace tabs (files, images, agents, terminals) • Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agent support • Multi-host cluster access
📖 Summary: Tabminal is a cloud-native terminal and workspace application designed for seamless use across desktop, tablet, and phone devices. It integrates persistent server-side terminal sessions, a built-in file and agent workspace, and support for the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) to provide a rich, intelligent, and persistent coding experience.
